title: Replay Warning Presentation
description: Presentation-safe replay safety warning container for Teams/Copilot acknowledgement flows.

warnings.description: Individual replay safety warnings. Order preserved from orchestrator.

severity.description: All replay warnings have HIGH severity.

fieldId.description: Registry field ID of the changed field.

message.description: Human-readable warning message from orchestrator. Verbatim — never rewritten.

priorValue.description: Prior-season value. Null when not set.

acknowledgementRequired.description: Always true — all replay warnings require acknowledgement.

totalWarnings.description: Total number of warnings in this container.

acknowledgementRequired.description: True when totalWarnings > 0. False when no warnings exist.
